system.summary: Florentine sign cipher of Rucellai's 1482 embassy (family 'HP', after its frequent null pair): substitution with invented signs, letters and digits, homophones, nulls (H P, 1 F, 9, V, D) and a few code signs (B, crossed equals, dotted o) not in the key; 35-37 sign types per letter. Two shapes long merged in transcription carry different values: q with barred descender = o, 'g' with open lower loop = e.
system.notes: Not the family '##' of Rucellai's 1483-85 letters (MAP XLVIII; Siena no. 11 / Gabbrielli no. 14 type). No key sheet found for HP in MAP LXXII 178-188 or in Gabbrielli's volume.

prior_solution.where: Catalogue 2350 vetting (6 Nov 2026) and repository search (14 Nov 2026): no decipherment of 196, 200, 202, 206, 211; Mallett's edition of Lorenzo's Lettere cites only 204-205. Comanducci 1996 (Rucellai's printed keys, Appendix III) not seen.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules (pre-registered and hashed tests, thresholds fixed in advance, one measurement per portion, no reuse of used portions). AI agents transcribed, built and tested the key, and read. No human palaeographer checked the transcription or the reading.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout
Claude Fable 5.2 (Anthropic), two API runs used as tools (14 Nov 2026)

solution.what: 207 and 204 transcribed by shape at 1272 px; 208 and 205 (contemporary clears) read.
Letter table K_T from the pair 207/208 (EM alignment with digraph rules, greedy tuning on 207 only).
One pre-registered test: K_T on the cipher of 204 against its contemporary clear 205: character agreement 0.6018 against at most 0.2281 for 200 shuffled keys; threshold 0.85: not validated.
Second pre-registered test after a second transcription pass of 207: glossed groups of LXXII 201 against their interlinear glosses: 0.5088 against at most 0.2832: not validated; 201 used up.

Two Claude Fable 5.2 API runs (lots 11 and 12) proposed rule corrections on 207/208 (fit 0.770, then 0.778) and values for signs found only in the bare letters; the lot 12 proposal did not improve the lexical coverage of 196, held out (0.254 against 0.246).
The q-like signs of 207 re-classed one by one at 4x (57 tokens): the old token g merged two shapes; the five bare letters transcribed again, blind, with the 207 convention (1320 tokens).

K_HP_v1: the lot 12 key recoded to the new classes (barred q = o, open-loop g = e); changes kept only if they did not lower the 207 fit and raised the Italian likelihood of held-out letters (leave one letter out); I = rr and dot = tt from the reading. Fit on 207: 0.8093 (best of 200 shuffled keys 0.340).

Consistency check, not a test: lexical coverage of the four unused bare letters 0.374 against at most 0.122 for 200 shuffled keys (none reaches the key). No HP passage with a clear is left unused, so the key cannot be measured on a fresh portion.

196, 200, 202, 206, 211 read word by word: sure + probable words cover 52-66 % of the decoded letters of the cipher runs; Ascanio, the Duke of Calabria, Montferrat, France, Genoa, Castelnuovo, Parma and the Ferrarese named.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key comes from the pair 207/208 (cipher and its contemporary decipherment in the same filza), refined on the transcriptions of the bare letters; tested once on 204/205 with an earlier version (0.6018, partial); no fresh portion is left for the present key.

validation.notes: Contributor's tests (not docs/_validate.py). Only protocol figure for the system: 0.6018 vs at most 0.2281 (204 against 205, earlier key K_T, 6 Nov 2026), below the 0.85 set in advance; 0.5088 vs 0.2832 on 201 (13 Nov). K_HP_v1 itself has no fresh test: fit 0.8093 on its training pair 207/208; lexical coverage 0.374 vs at most 0.122 for 200 shuffled keys on 200, 202, 206, 211 (consistency check).

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading/lxxii*.md (14 Nov 2026): sure + probable words cover 52-66 % of the decoded letters of the cipher runs per letter (196 64 %, 200 66 %, 202 52 %, 206 66 %, 211 53 %); clear words of the letters not counted.

the decipherments of the time: LXXII 208 ('Decifrato della n. 207'), used to build the key, and 205 (clear of 204), used for the test of 6 Nov 2026

texts.label: ASF MAP LXXII 196, Rucellai to Spina, 3 July 1482
texts.summary: About Ascanio Sforza's conditions and confinement ('Ascanio fu confinato'); Castelnuovo, Parma, a Count Giovanni, Bologna and the Marquis of Montferrat are named.

reading_review.note: Cipher runs read word by word with K_HP_v1 under the strict notation (sure / probable / restored / unresolved); sure + probable words cover about 64 % of the decoded letters; read in part; partial key, not validated on a fresh portion.
